authority_context_note: CDX017 is a STANDALONE_AUTHORITY_SURFACE capsule (S2-accepted classification, #589 comment 5845654192). Every source-defining state of the shell renders from the locked authority plus the four assets that live inside its own selected folder (버전4-선택/assets), so the capsule vendors exactly those four files byte-exact under original/assets/ and split/assets/ with ZERO URL rewrites. The four authored downstream portal destinations are PORTAL_DESTINATION_ONLY: their relative paths are preserved byte for byte and their target corpora are deliberately NOT vendored (CENTRAL: S3 does not need to vendor the four downstream portal target corpora). Consequently the shell-owned runtime surface at the repository path IS runtime-equivalent for the loader, all four chapters, wheel, keyboard, menu, Living Index, sound, pointer parallax, water, home and the portal transition/open/close chrome; the portal iframe body itself resolves to 404 at the repository path for BOTH original and split, exactly as it did in the accepted S2 capture where the four targets were intentionally left unhydrated. This is a recorded serving fact, not a source defect and not a parity claim.

capture_surface.runtime_equivalence_exclusion: The four authored portal destination documents are not vendored, so the portal iframe body is not available at the repository path. Shell-owned portal chrome (clip-path transition, rAF counter, toolbar title, Open new href, close and src reset) is fully in-surface and parity-comparable.

shared_harness_disposition.detail: All four shared scripts enumerate only src/03_sources directories matching ^SRC\d{3}$ and therefore never address src/04_codex/CDX017. Unlike CDX014 (CONTEXT_AWARE_ONLY, whose repository path is NOT a runtime surface and which records an explicit SKIP), CDX017 needs no skip disposition: its repository original and split surfaces ARE runtime surfaces once served with their own assets/ directory. No shared harness file was modified and no skip was fabricated.

capture_surface.note: S4 parity is NOT started and NOT claimed by this capsule. Per the S2 nondeterminism contract (#589 comment 5845654192) raw PNG byte equality is not a valid S4 acceptance rule for this source, and no SSIM / perceptual / pixel threshold is proposed or recorded here. S4 will compare ORIGINAL vs SPLIT using source-specific structural/state/geometry parity plus a CENTRAL-approved bounded visual method, under a separate S4 release.

source_contract.qa_hook_note: No source-native QA hook exists. S2 assertions were DOM / geometry / computed-style / runtime-snapshot based. No test-only hook, global animation disable, Date freeze, performance.now patch, requestAnimationFrame patch or Math.random override was used or injected.
source_contract.external_network_dependencies_note: The only http(s)-shaped string in the authority is the SVG namespace URI http://www.w3.org/2000/svg inside the inline data:-URI turbulence grain. There is no external font, script, stylesheet, XHR, fetch or media dependency.
source_contract.preview_helper_note: Authoring aids only. They set loader.style.display='none' and, for preview=index, force inline transition:none plus immediate visibility, so they bypass the loader and produce a jump-cut. They are NOT S4 acceptance authority. Preserved unchanged; no cleanup performed.

frozen_defects.name: header Back button runs history.back() and can leave the shell
frozen_defects.note: When history.length>1 (a normal first tab load already has length 2 because of about:blank + the page), the Back button calls history.back() instead of the intended setChapter(0) fallback. S2 proved this: performance.timeOrigin changed and location.href became about:blank, destroying the shell document. The setChapter(0) fallback is unreachable through ordinary navigation. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: prefers-reduced-motion does not reduce loader, chapter, keyboard, portal-transition or sound timing
frozen_defects.note: Reduced motion is implemented in two places only: a CSS media block that collapses animation/transition durations to .01ms, and one JS guard inside addFlow(). Loader rAF timing, the 950ms+170ms gate, chapter navigation, keyboard input, the 900ms portal rAF tick, the 780/470ms timeouts and sound scheduling are all unaffected. S2 measured the reduced-motion portal rAF counter at 048 where the normal run read 049 at the same 430ms mark. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: pointermove pushes water ripples directly, bypassing the addFlow reduced-motion guard
frozen_defects.note: addFlow() returns early under reduced motion, but the pointermove handler pushes {kind:'ripple'} marks straight onto waterMarks, so residual animated water still draws. S2 measured 824 non-transparent canvas samples under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce versus 4900 in a normal-motion run. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: no focus management when menu, Living Index or portal opens
frozen_defects.note: Opening an overlay never moves focus into the panel, and Escape-driven closing leaves focus unchanged. S2 observed document.activeElement still on menuBtn, the menu link and talkBtn respectively at the open states. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: aria-hidden panels stay keyboard reachable (no inert, no focus trap)
frozen_defects.note: Closed panels carry aria-hidden=true while their buttons remain tabbable, and the document exposes 22 tabbable controls in every captured state. The authority declares no tabindex attributes at all. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: rolling-label duplication pollutes accessible names
frozen_defects.note: Each label is rendered twice for the rolling animation, so button accessible names read HomeHome, '01HomeHome' and '01 / 04Living worldBiosphere'. S2 captured the doubled label list verbatim. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: the back affordance disappears below 900px with no mobile alternative
frozen_defects.note: CSS media max-width:900px sets .back-btn display:none. S2 measured a 0x0 backBtn box at both 390x844 and 320x720. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: cursor:none is unconditional on fine pointers and the replacement tracks pointermove only
frozen_defects.note: .app{cursor:none} applies to every fine-pointer device, and the custom cursor element is driven only by pointer events, so a keyboard-only user gets no usable pointer affordance. pointer:coarse is the only escape. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: body user-select:none disables text selection everywhere
frozen_defects.note: Selection is disabled document-wide, including the Living Index descriptive copy. DO NOT FIX.

frozen_defects.name: preview query helpers mutate inline styles and are not acceptance authority
frozen_defects.note: ?preview=menu|index|water|portal|portalopen set loader.style.display='none' and preview=index also forces inline transition:none plus immediate visibility, so those states are jump-cuts that bypass the authored loader and transition. They are authoring aids; S4 must compare against the non-preview states. DO NOT FIX and DO NOT clean up.
